title: Wrong-language letters get a candidate fix: pick our language on the stop page
deviations_from_card: Critic revision applied: app/api/pipeline/route.ts and app/api/jobs/[id]/candidates/outreach/route.ts dropped (S leftover below), acceptance 6 cut to inferProfileLocale(candidateId, ws). db/pipeline.ts swapped out of the write set for a new leaf app/_lib/db/pipeline-locale.ts (setCandidateChosenLocale + entryLocaleChosen, imported only by the stop door): putting them in pipeline.ts cost ~3 KB on ~25 route graphs sitting at their ceilings, and the leaf imported from comms-locale cost +1 module on 13 overrides; the inference-side reader chosenLocaleForCandidate therefore lives in comms-locale.ts over ensureDb (core is already on that graph) so no graph gains a module and no perf ceiling was raised. Beyond the card: a second code STOP_LANGUAGE_FAILED (STORE_ERRORS, the route's 500) beside STOP_LANGUAGE_INVALID; the existing stop-token-route.test.ts allowlist pin updated to the new 5-field projection; route-capability-coverage.test.ts (contract, under lock) gains the language door as a public token door; the body is read through readJsonWithLimit (256 B named cap) per public-body-cap-contract. 15 cases = 9 route/inference cases + 6 pure offer cases (card's 7 acceptance lines, some split).
notes: public-routes.ts:90 '/api/stop/' confirmed to admit /api/stop/[token]/language (api-reference lists it public); no public-routes change. Route posture: rateLimit(stop-language:<ip>:<token>, 20/min) BEFORE findEntryByOptOutToken, unknown token -> STOP_LINK_INVALID 404 (and 404 if the UPDATE changes 0 rows), bad locale -> STOP_LANGUAGE_INVALID 400 with nothing written, tenant off the token row, no requireCapability-style guard (public token door, allowlisted with reason). setCandidateChosenLocale is ONE UPDATE (no read->write; last choice wins) over the token entry + same non-empty candidate_id in the same workspace, skipping anonymized rows; never touches outreach state (test pins candidateOptOutHalt stays null). New column pipeline_entries.locale_chosen_at TEXT (additive, nullable; no tenancy change, table already scoped). Shared commits made under the lock with ONLY my hunks: docs/architecture/api-reference.md and app/api/route-capability-coverage.test.ts were staged as HEAD+my-hunk blobs because the working tree also carried devcase-lifecycle/B's uncommitted /api/devcase/[id]/intake row and allowlist edit - those remain uncommitted in the working tree for that builder. tsc exit is non-zero on the whole tree only from foreign paths (untracked kpi-sim/ copy of the tree, and devcase-lifecycle/B in flight); my paths are clean. test:unit residual reds are foreign: recipes-literals (DevCaseDetailChannels/Header chipQuiet) and devcase-studio-robustness (devcase-lifecycle/B uncommitted), python-runner-concurrency process-tree (environmental). test:perf: check-budget green on a git-archive of committed HEAD (my work included); working-tree red lines come only from siblings' uncommitted files. review:constitution 0 blocking, 1 note (gate-configuration: rate-limit-contract.test.ts edited to pin the new limiter, as the card requires). Recruiter surfaces do not display the chosen flag (card scope); every letter and link pin already resolves through resolveCommsLocale, so they follow the choice unchanged. loop_open: S leftover for comms-locale-optout - app/api/pipeline/route.ts:159 and app/api/jobs/[id]/candidates/outreach/route.ts:114 call inferProfileLocale(body.candidateId) without the ws they hold; on a non-default workspace a NEW entry filed by those two doors misses both the candidate's chosen locale and the CV inference (stores NULL -> team default). Fix: pass ws as the second argument (named as a known gap in docs/features/comms/README.md section 10).
